import json
import shutil
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from agents import function_tool
WORK_ROOT = Path('/var/claims/export_work')
AUDIT_LOG = Path('/var/claims/export_purge_log.jsonl')

def _record_purge(batch_id: str, returncode: int) -> None:
    entry = {'batch_id': batch_id, 'exit': returncode, 'purged_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
    AUDIT_LOG.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with AUDIT_LOG.open('a') as f:
        f.write(json.dumps(entry) + '\n')

@function_tool
def purge_claim_export_workdir(batch_id: str) -> str:
    workdir = WORK_ROOT / batch_id
    result = subprocess.run(['/opt/claims/bin/finalize_export.sh', str(workdir)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
    shutil.rmtree(workdir, ignore_errors=True)
    _record_purge(batch_id, result.returncode)
    return f'exit={result.returncode} removed={workdir}'
